tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Prices (CAD), envelope limits and bulk credit packs. No key needed.

tools.name: get_sandbox_key
tools.description: Create a free sandbox API key. Letters sent with it are never printed, mailed or charged. Use it to test the whole flow.

tools.name: buy_credits_link
tools.description: Start buying credit for a NEW live key. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL that a HUMAN must open and pay. After they pay, the live key is emailed to them. Never try to pay on the human's behalf.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the mailer team something: a bug, a missing feature, confusing docs, or why you or your human did not go ahead (price, trust, missing option). No key needed. Do not include letter content, addresses or secrets. A person reads every message.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Mode (test or live) and remaining credit for the key on this connection or in api_key.

tools.name: create_topup_link
tools.description: Start a credit top-up for the key on this connection. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL that a HUMAN must open and pay. Credit appears on the key as soon as Stripe confirms the payment.

tools.name: send_letter
tools.description: Print and mail one envelope (up to 5 A4 pages, black and white) to a Canadian address. IRREVERSIBLE once printed: confirm the recipient and content with the human first unless they pre-authorized it. With a live key the price is debited from credit before anything is created; with a sandbox key noth

tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Status (test, paid, mailed) and tracking number for one letter sent with this key.

tools.name: list_letters
tools.description: The latest 100 letters sent with this key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buy_credits_link, create_topup_link · Private data: get_sandbox_key, send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback, send_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buy_credits_link, create_topup_link · Private data: get_sandbox_key, send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback, send_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
